caption: Figure 10. Memory footprint of CUDA Graph for SD. S1∼S4 denote different SD strategies, B1∼B4 represent batch- size buckets. Memory and throughput values are illustrative.
subject: how bucketing, disaggregating, and merging CUDAGraph captures cuts memory growth while keeping multi-strategy speculative-decoding throughput gains

groups.why_chosen: Capturing one CUDAGraph per strategy wastes memory linearly with strategy count; bucketing batch sizes, disaggregating target/draft capture, and merging strategies that share parameters keeps memory nearly flat while still gaining the throughput of many adaptive strategies.
groups.what_to_learn: A two-line check/cross scorecard under every alternative; roman numerals for the sub-steps that build the winner
